post.summary: Submit Bill of Lading - Submit required transit information in order to create a waybill/bill of lading (BOL).

201.description:
**Created**

The request successfully created a new resource.

400.description:
**Bad Request**

The request could not be understood by the server due to incorrect syntax. Do not repeat the request without modifications.

403.description:
**Forbidden**

Unauthorized request. Here are the most common causes:
    
* You are getting 403 Access Denied.

   * It takes a few days for us to get you set up after you register. When set up is complete, you will receive an email letting you know. If you have not received the email, please wait up to five business days. Let us know via API Support if you still have not received the email after five business days.
   * You can also get this error if your certificate is not configured properly on your side. Please review the Mutual Authentication in the Getting Started section of our documentation.


* You are getting 403 "message": "Insufficient privileges" when accessing a restricted service for which you do not have permission. You can use our Registration form to request access. Be sure to explain the situation in the "Please explain how you intend to use the API" field.

404.description:
**Not Found**

The server cannot find the requested resource (URI). That is, the address of the endpoint in your request does not exist. Please consult the documentation.

405.description:
**Method Not Allowed**

The request HTTP method is known by the server but has been disabled and cannot be used for that resource. For example, you may be using GET when POST is required. Please consult the documentation.

429.description:
**Too Many Requests**

The BNSF API Gateway enforces rate limits to maintain application security and performance.  Current rate limits are set as follows:
* 1 API Request Per Second, Per Partner, Per Service
* 15 API Requests Per Minute, Per Partner, Per Service
* 100 API Request Per Minute, Per Service
 
When requests exceed these limits the API Gateway will return a **429 Too Many Requests** error response. Upon receiving such exceptions, you can resubmit failed requests in a rate-limited manner, complying with the API Gateway throttle limits.

500.description:
**Internal Server Error**

The server encountered an unexpected condition which prevented it from fulfilling the request. This is always a problem on the server side. Our internal support systems will be made aware.

504.description:
**Gateway Timeout**

The server is acting as a gateway and cannot get a response in time for a request. Wait about one minute then try again.

get.summary: Retrieve Waybill - Retrieve current active waybill/bill of lading information for a given equipment.

billOfLadingEdiQualifierCode.description:
EDI Shipment Qualifier Code is an EDI-defined qualifier code value specifying the relationship a shipment with respect to other shipments given to the carrier at the same time.

Sample Values Include: 1 (Master Bill for Empty Non-Revenue Equipment), 2 (Sea Waybill), E (Empty Equipment Billing (Non-Revenue)), I (Intermodal)

**EDI Mapping:** DE147/BX07

billOfLadingEdiWeightMethodTypeCode.description:
EDI Weight Method Type Code is an EDI-defined code value indicating the method by which freight conveyance equipment weights are obtained for a shipment.

Sample Values Include: C (Consignee Scale Weight), E (Estimated Weight), H (Public Scale Weight on Behalf of Shipper), O (Official Weight)

**EDI Mapping:** DE460/BNX01

billOfLadingEdiWeightUomCode.description:
EDI Weight Unit of Measure Code is an EDI-defined code value specifying the weight unit of an associated measurement.

Sample Values Are: E (Metric Ton), G (Grams), K (Kilograms), L (Pounds), M (Measurement Ton), O (Ounces), S (Short Ton), T (Long Ton)

**EDI Mapping:** DE188/BX06

billOfLadingEdiMethodOfPaymentCode.description:
EDI Method of Payment Code is an EDI-defined code value specifying payment terms for transportation charges.

Sample Values Include: 11 (Association of American Railroads Accounting Rule 11 Shipment), CC (Collect), MX (Mixed), NC (Service Freight, No Charge), NR (Non Revenue), PP (Prepaid (by Seller))

**EDI Mapping:** DE146/BX03

billOfLadingEdiTransactionSetPurposeCode.description:
EDI Transaction Set Purpose Code is an EDI-defined code value specifying the purpose of an associated transaction set.

Sample Values Include: 00 (Original), 04 (Change)

**EDI Mapping:** DE353/BX01

billOfLadingEdiTransportationTypeCode.description:
Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the method or type of transportation for a shipment.

**EDI Mapping:** DE91/ZC108/BX02

billOfLadingEdiSectionSevenCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value indicating the applicability of the section seven option on a shipment.

billOfLadingEdiBillingTypeCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value which indicates a type of bill.

equipmentEdiReleaseCode.description: EDI Equipment Release Code is an EDI-defined code value signifying whether or not the shipment information transaction set includes instructions for pickup and movement of the shipment.

equipmentReleaseDateTime.description: Equipment Release DateTime records the date and time which a shipper's equipment is released to BNSF.

equipmentReleaseDateTimeOffsetNumber.description: Equipment Release DateTime Offset Number is the amount of time subtracted from or added to the Coordinated Universal Time to get the time supplied for the equipment release date-time.

billOfLadingCargoManifestSequenceNumber.description: BOL Cargo Manifest Sequence Number allows for more than one Cargo Manifest per BOL. The EDI standard allows for a maximum of two.

voyageNumber.description: Identifying designator number for the particular ocean movement on which the cargo travels.

oceanPortFunctionalCode.description: Code defining function performed at the port with respect to a shipment.

oceanPortName.description: Free-form name for the place at which an offshore carrier/vessel originates or terminates its actual ocean carriage of property.

vesselSailDockEdiDate.description: The date the ship will sailed or docked at the port. Present if Ocean Port Functional Code contains a 'L", 'D' or '1'.

vesselBookingNumber.description: Number assigned by the carrier for space reservation on a voyage.

currentScac.description: Current SCAC (Standard Carrier Alpha Code) provided by EDI

previousScac.description: Previous SCAC (Standard Carrier Alpha Code) provided by EDI

billOfLadingManifestDate.description: The date the manifest was established by the shipper.

vesselName.description: Name of the vessel as documented in "Lloyd's Register of Ships".

oceanPierNumber.description: Identifying number for the pier located within the Ocean Port Name.

oceanPierName.description: Identifying name for the pier located within the Ocean Port Name.

oceanTerminalName.description: Identifying name for the terminal located within the Ocean Port Name.

oceanTerminalStateCode.description: Identifying state code for the terminal located within the Ocean Port Name.

oceanTerminalCountryCode.description: Identifying country code for the terminal located within the Ocean Port Name.

cargoManifestReferenceId.description: Cargo Manifest Reference ID is a reference identifier for Vessel Agent Number.

billOfLadingCommodities.description:
Specifies a shipment's lading information for each commodity in terms of description, marks, and numbers.


**EDI Mapping:** LX,L5

billOfLadingCommoditySequenceNumber.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID and BOL Commodity Sequence Number, uniquely identifies a row on the BOL Commodity Detail element.

billOfLadingTransactionSetAssignedNumber.description:
Is a number assigned for differentiation within a BOL transaction set.

**EDI Mapping:** DE554/LX01

ladingLineItemNumber.description:
Lading Line Item Number is the sequential line number for a lading item within a shipment.

**EDI Mapping:** DE213/L501

stcc.description:
STCC (Standard Transportation Commodity Code) assigned to a lading commodity or group of lading commodities.

**EDI Mapping:** DE22/L503

stccEdiQualifierCode.description:
Is an EDI-defined code value that identifies the commodity coding system used for an associated Commodity Code.

Sample Values Include: 0 (National Association of Convenience Stores), 1 (Global Product Classification Code (GPC)), 2 (Dun s SIC 2+2, Dun and Bradstreet), 3 (Empty Non-hazardous Last Contained (HMRC) Code)

**EDI Mapping:** DE23/L504/L508

ladingDescription.description:
Lading Description describes a lading item as required for rating and billing purposes.

**EDI Mapping:** DE79/L502

billOfLadingCommodityDetails.description:
Specifies a shipment's detailed lading information for each line item, including packaging, quantity, weight, and volume.

**EDI Mapping:** L0

billOfLadingCommodityDetailSequenceNumbe.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID and BOL Commodity Sequence Number, uniquely identifies a row on the BOL Commodity Detail element.

ladingQuantityCount.description:
Number of units (pieces) of the lading commodity.

**EDI Mapping:** DE80/X110

ladingEdiPackagingFormCode.description:
Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the packaging form of a lading quantity.

Sample Values Include: BLK (Bulk), CAR (Carrier), CNT (Container), CRT (Crate), PLT (Pallet)

**EDI Mapping:** DE211/L009/L014

ladingWeight.description:
Lading Weight is a measure of the weight of a lading item. This must be qualified with a code defining the unit of measure to be meaningful.

**EDI Mapping:** DE81/L004

ladingEdiWeightQualifierCode.description:
Is an EDI-defined code value that identifies the manner in which the weight of a piece of freight conveyance equipment was calculated.

Sample Values Include: A (Consolidated Weight), B (Billed Weight), L (Legal Weight), N (Actual Net Weight)

**EDI Mapping:** DE187/L005

ladingVolume.description:
Lading Volume is a volumetric measure of a lading item. This must be qualified with a code defining the unit of measure used to be meaningful.

**EDI Mapping:** DE183/L006

ladingEdiVolumeUnitCode.description:
Is an EDI-defined qualifier code value that provides context to a volume measurement.

Sample Values Include: C (Cubic Centimeters), E (Cubic Feet), G (Gallons), M (Cubic Decimeters)

**EDI Mapping:** DE184/L007

billOfLadingPrices.description:
Relates a line item in a shipment to the authority document, contract number, quote number, and tariff number which are used to determine the basis of pricing.


**EDI Mapping:** LX Loop/LX,L0,PI

billOfLadingPriceSequenceNumber.description: Is a sequence number that is needed to uniquely identify a price associated with a commodity on the BOL.

billOfLadingLineItemPriceReferenceEdiQua.description:
Is an EDI-defined qualifier code value that provides context to the value present in the EDI Reference ID column.


**EDI Mapping:** DE128/PI01

billOfLadingLineItemPriceReferenceId.description:
Is a reference identification number for the BOL Price element.

**EDI Mapping:** DE127/PI02

publicationAuthorityEdiTypeCode.title: publicationAuthorityEdiTypeCode
publicationAuthorityEdiTypeCode.description:
Is an EDI-defined code value that specifies the type of external price publication provided for a line item in a shipment.

Sample Values Are: BR (Backward Reference), DR (Division Reference), GR (Group Reference), OP (Other Publication), RR (Rate Reference), TP (Tariff Publication)

**EDI Mapping:** DE436/PI03

priceAuthorityAgencyCode.description:
Price Authority Agency Code is a code value, as defined by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association, specifying the tariff bureau or tariff publishing agent that governs the pricing/rates applied to a shipment.

Codes sourced from the Directory of Standard Carrier Alpha Codes (SCAC), NMF 101 Series, available from  the National Motor Freight Traffic Association, Inc.

**EDI Mapping:** DE168/PI05

priceAuthorityIssuingCarrierId.description:
Price Authority Issuing Carrier ID is an identification label used to identify the issuing carrier of a price authority specified on a shipment.

**EDI Mapping:** DE965/PI06

billOfLadingExportLicenseSequenceNumber.description: In combination with a BOL ID, uniquely identifies a row in the BOL Export License element.

licensingAgencyEdiCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value used to identify a licensing, certification, registration, or accreditation agency associated with a commodity being shipped.

exportLicenseId.description: Export License ID is a government assigned identification number for exporter.

exportLicenseEdiStatusCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying whether the shipment completes the terms of the export license, or the shipment is only a partial delivery relative to the license terms.

exportLicenseExpirationDate.description: Is the day, month, and year when an export license expires (expressed as CCYYMMDD where CC represents the first two digits of the calendar year).

exportLicenseEdiSymbolCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value which specifies the export license symbol marked on a shipment.

exportLicenseEdiControlCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the type of control applicable to an export license.

exportLicenseCountryCode.description: Export License Country Code is an ISO 3166 code value specifying a country, dependency, or geopolitical area in which an exporter operates.

commodityScheduleBNumber.description:
Schedule B Number is a classification and identification code for commodities for use by exporters in preparing Shippers Export Declarations.

The code is a ten digit numeric of the form dddd.dd.dddd. 

Codes sourced from the Schedule B Statistical Classification of Domestic and Foreign Commodities Exported from the United States, 1990 Edition. Maintained by the U.S. Bureau of the Census.

billOfLadingEdiInternationalDomesticCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying whether a shipment is international or domestic.

ladingQuantityCount.description: Lading Quantity Count is a count of the number of units (pieces) of the lading commodity.

ladingValueAmount.description: Lading Value Amount specifies the monetary value of a shipment for export, expressed in the standard monetary denomination for the currency specified.

exportLicenseEdiFilingKeyCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying whether the information contained on an export license has been filed with Customs via an automatic or manual process.

ediUomCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the units in which a value is being expressed, or manner in which a measurement has been taken.

ladingUnitPrice.description: Lading Unit Price is the price per unit of a commodity.

usGovernmentLicenseTypeCode.description: The type of U.S. government license being used on the export license associated with a shipment.

eccn.description: Export Control Classification Number is a designation used on the Commerce Control List (CCL) to identify dual-use items for export control purposes.

billOfLadingEquipment.description:
Provides detail information about the rail conveyance equipment on the BOL.


**EDI Mapping:** N7 Loop/L0,N7,T2

billOfLadingEquipmentSequenceNumber.description:
Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL Identifer, uniquely identifies a piece of freight conveyance equipment on a BOL.
The purpose of the sequence number is to preserve the order of equipment as supplied on the EDI  404 or other channel. Sequence values should start from one (1) and increment by one for each piece of equipment on the request.

equipmentId.description:
Equipment ID serves as an identifier for a piece of freight conveyance equipment. It consists of a 4-character equipment initial followed by an up to 15-character equipment unit identifying number.

**EDI Mapping:** DE206-207/N804/N805

equipmentLoadEmptyStatusCode.description: Load Empty Status Code is used to convey whether a piece of rail conveyance equipment (i.e., a railcar) is being shipped while laden with cargo or while empty, as is the case if it does not pick up another load at its destination.

equipmentEdiWeightQualifierCode.description:
EDI Weight Qualifier Code is an EDI-defined code value that identifies the manner in which the weight of a piece of freight conveyance equipment was calculated.

Sample Values Include: A (Consolidated Weight), B (Billed Weight), L (Legal Weight), N (Actual Net Weight)

**EDI Mapping:** DE187/N704/L005/T204

equipmentWeight.description:
BOL Equipment Weight is the numeric value of the weight of a shipment as it appears on a BOL. This must be qualified with a code defining the type of weight (i.e., Estimated Net Weight, Gross Weight, Actual Net Weight) used to be meaningful.

EDI specifies that dunnage weight must be included and is limited to 8 digits for rail transactions. The numeric value of the residue weight is required for trans-border residue empty moves into the U.S.  The Equipment Weight Qualifier indicate the type of weight measured.

**EDI Mapping:** DE81/N703

equipmentEdiTypeCode.description:
EDI Equipment Type Code is an EDI-defined code value specifying the method or type of transportation used for the shipment.

Sample Values Include: 20 (20 ft. IL Container (Open Top)), AA (Air Ride Van), AC (Closed Container), BX (Boxcar)

**EDI Mapping:** DE40/N711

equipmentTareWeight.description:
Equipment Tare Weight is the weight of an empty rail shipping container or vehicle. Sometimes called the unladen weight.

**EDI Mapping:** DE167/N705

equipmentExteriorLengthFeetInches.description:
Is the length (in feet and inches) of equipment ordered or used to transport shipment. The format is FFFII where FFF is feet and II is inches. The range for II is 00 through 11.  Outside length required for intermodal equipment.

**EDI Mapping:** DE567/N715

equipmentCheckDigitNumber.description: Equipment Check Digit Number designates the check digit applied to a piece of equipment, which serves as a form of redundancy check used for error detection.

equipmentAllowanceWeight.description: Equipment Allowance Weight is the permitted increase in the weight of a piece of shipping equipment due to such factors as snow.

equipmentDunnageWeight.description: Equipment Dunnage Weight is the combined weight of the materials used to protect the lading being transported on the freight conveyance equipment (even bracings, false floors, etc.).

equipmentOwnerScac.description: Equipment Owner SCAC is the standard carrier alpha code for the owner of the associated freight conveyance equipment.

equipmentEdiOwnershipCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the relationship of a piece of equipment to the carrier it belongs to.

equipmentPositionNumber.description: Equipment Position Number specifies the relative position of a shipment within the associated freight conveyance equipment (car, trailer, or container).

equipmentExteriorHeightInches.description: Is the exterior vertical dimension of a piece of freight conveyance equipment, measured in inches when the object is in the upright position.

equipmentExteriorWidthInches.description: Is the exterior width of a piece of freight conveyance equipment, measured in inches when the object is in the upright position.

equipmentAarCarTypeCode.description: Equipment AAR Car Type Code is an AAR-maintained code value used to identify a type of rail car or intermodal equipment type and its general characteristics.

equipmentIsoContainerTypeCode.description: Equipment ISO Container Type Code is an ISO 6346-defined code value used to specify the type of a shipping container.

billOfLadingEquipmentSeals.description:
Records seal numbers used to close openings on a piece of rail conveyance equipment.

**EDI Mapping:** M7

billOfLadingEquipmentSealSequenceNumber.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID and BOL Equipment Sequence Number uniquely identifies a seal associated with the freight conveyance equipment on a BOL.

equipmentSealNumber.description:
Is a unique number on seal used to close a shipment.

**EDI Mapping:** DE225/M701

billOfLadingEquipmentReferenceSequenceNu.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID and BOL Equipment Sequence Number, uniquely identifies a piece equipment reference information on a Shipment.

equipmentReferenceEdiQualifierCode.description: Is an EDI-defined qualifier code value that provides context to the value present in the 'EDI Reference ID' column.

equipmentReferenceId.description: Equipment Reference ID is a reference identification number for the 'BOL Equipment Reference' table.

equipmentReferenceDescription.description: Equipment Reference Description is a free-form description explaining the significance of the reference information attached to the freight conveyance equipment.

billOfLadingCustomsInBondSequenceNumber.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID and BOL Equipment Sequence Number, uniquely identifies a row in the BOL Customs In Bond element.

customsEntryTypeCode.description: Customs Entry Type Code is an EDI-defined code value specifying the type of entry assigned by U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP).

customsEntryNumber.description: Customs Entry Number is the Automated Commercial System Code furnished by U.S. Customs Service.

oceanPortLocationCode.description: Is a location identifier for a port where shipments are exported or received.

foreignOceanPortLocationCode.description: Contains a five-digit numeric census Schedule K code which identifies a foreign port of destination.

inBondShipmentValueAmount.description: In-bond Shipment Value Amount is the value of the in bond shipment in whole dollars, as required by US Customs.

inBondShipmentControlNumber.description: Is assigned to an import or export shipment that hasn't been cleared by US Customs and serves as a means of telling shipments apart while simultaneously identifying the carrier transporting the shipment.

inBondShipmentReferenceEdiQualifierCode.description: Is an EDI-defined qualifier code value that provides context to the value present in the 'In-bond Shipment Reference Identification Number' column.

inBondShipmentReferenceIdentificationNum.description: For any value held in this column is contextualized and given meaning by the code value of the associated "In-bond Shipment Reference EDI Qualifier Code".

inBondShipmentEdiTransportationTypeCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the method or type of transportation for a shipment.

vesselName.description: Name of the vessel as documented in "Lloyd's Register of Ships".

billOfLadingEquipmentQuantityAndDescript.description:
Count of the number of packages, of a specific commodity, Description of the commodity to be shipped on a railcar as defined on the BOL (Bill of Lading).

**EDI Mapping:** N10 Loop/N7,REF,N10

Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL Identifer, uniquely identifies a piece of freight conveyance equipment on a BOL.
The purpose of the sequence number is to preserve the order of equipment as supplied on the EDI  404 or other channel. Sequence values should start from one (1) and increment by one for each piece of equipment on the request.

billOfLadingEquipmentQuantity.description:
Count of the number of packages, of a specific commodity, to be shipped on a railcar as defined on the BOL (Bill of Lading).

**EDI Mapping:** N10/01

billOfLadingEquipmentQuantityDescription.description:
Description of the commodity to be shipped on a railcar as defined on the BOL (Bill of Lading).

**EDI Mapping:** N10/02

billOfLadingEquipmentWeightUnitCode.description:
Code that defines the standard UOM (Unit of Measure) to be applied to the BOL (Bill of Lading) Commodity Item Weight value.

**EDI Mapping:** N10/07

billOfLadingEquipmentWeight.description:
The weight of the specific commodity within a given railcar as defined on the BOL (Bill of Lading). See also "BOL Commodity Item Weight UOM Code."

**EDI Mapping:** N10/08

billOfLadingEquipmentManifestCode.description:
Code specifying the smallest type of package a commodity can be bundled into for shipping on a railcar as defined on the BOL (Bill of Lading.)

**EDI Mapping:** N10/10

billOfLadingEquipmentOriginCountryCode.description:
Code that defines the origin country of a commodity as defined on the BOL (Bill of Lading.).

**EDI Mapping:** N10/11

billOfLadingEquipmentDestinationCountryC.description:
Code that defines the destination country of a commodity as defined on the BOL (Bill of Lading.).

**EDI Mapping:** N10/12

billOfLadingSpecialHandlingInstructions.description:
Records the codes provided by the shipper that specify how a commodity or piece of equipment is processed/handled on the BOL.

**EDI Mapping:** H3

specialHandlingInstructionsSequenceNumbe.description: Special Handling Instruction Sequence Number is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID, uniquely identifies an occurrence in the BOL Special Handling Instruction group.

specialCarHandlingCode.description:
Is an EDI-defined code value specifying special transportation handling instructions that must be applied to a shipment.

Sample Values Include: AJ (Do Not Stack), AH (Humidity Sensitive Shipment), FR (Fragile - Handle with Care), DNF (Do Not Freeze)

**EDI Mapping:** DE152/H301

billOfLadingRouteSequences.description:
Describes the carrier and routing (interchange) sequence for rail transportation of a shipment from origin to destination.  

**EDI Mapping:** R2

billOfLadingRouteSequenceNumber.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID, uniquely identifies a row in the BOL Route Sequence element.

billOfLadingRoute.description: Describes the carrier and routing (interchange) sequence for rail transportation of a shipment from origin to destination.

carrierEdiShipmentRoutingSequenceCode.description:
Carrier EDI Shipment Routing Sequence Code describes the relationship of a carrier to a specific shipment movement.

Sample Values Include: 1 (1st Carrier after Origin Carrier), 9 (9th Carrier after Origin Carrier), D (Delivery Switch Carrier), I (Origin Switch Carrier), R (Origin Carrier, Rule 11 Shipment)

**EDI Mapping:** DE133/R202/E502

scac.description:
SCAC (Standard Carrier Alpha Code) consists of a two to four character alpha abbreviation used to designate a transportation company. SCACs are assigned by NMFTA (National Motor Freight Traffic Association).

**EDI Mapping:** DE140/CM06

r260JunctionName.description:
Route Junction Name is the junction name (as specified by AAR Accounting Rule 260) of the interchange for a segment of the route. This information represents the beginning of service for intermediate and interline received rail shipments.
The city name of the rail location/interchange for this segment of the route on the BOL.

**EDI Mapping:** DE19/E503/R203

intermodalServiceCode.description:
Intermodal Service Code identifies the Intermodal Service Plan. Required on intermodal shipments. Required on intermodal shipments (BX02 = 'X') when N711 contains 'CC', 'CH', 'CM', 'CN', 'CX', 'CZ', 'GS', 'LS', 'OT', 'PL', 'PT', 'RT' or 'TL'

**EDI Mapping:** DE177/R205

billOfLadingDestinationLocation.description:
Specifies the rail locations related to the BOL such as origin (station) and destination (station).

**EDI Mapping:** F9,D9

fsac.description:
FSAC (Freight Station Accounting Code) is a number assigned to a station that uniquely identifies the station within the context of each reporting railroad (i.e., Different railroads might share identical FSAC numbers).

**EDI Mapping:** DE573/PS06

stationCityName.description:
Is a fully qualified name of a city for a given station.

**EDI Mapping:** DE19/G401

stationStateCode.description:
Is a code value, as defined by the appropriate government agency of the United States, Canada, or Mexico, specifying a state or province.

Codes sourced from the U.S. Postal Service, Canada Post, or Bureau of Transportation Statistics.

**EDI Mapping:** DE156/PS08

billOfLadingOriginLocation.description:
Specifies the rail locations related to the BOL such as origin (station) and destination (station).

**EDI Mapping:** F9,D9

fsac.description:
FSAC (Freight Station Accounting Code) is a number assigned to a station that uniquely identifies the station within the context of each reporting railroad (i.e., Different railroads might share identical FSAC numbers).

**EDI Mapping:** DE573/PS06

stationCityName.description:
Is a fully qualified name of a city for a given station.

**EDI Mapping:** DE19/G401

stationStateCode.description:
Is a code value, as defined by the appropriate government agency of the United States, Canada, or Mexico, specifying a state or province.

Codes sourced from the U.S. Postal Service, Canada Post, or Bureau of Transportation Statistics.

**EDI Mapping:** DE156/PS08

billOfLadingParties.description:
Specifies role and location (address) information for parties associated with a BOL.

**EDI Mapping:** N1 Loop/N1, N2, N3, PER

billOfLadingPartySequenceNumber.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID, uniquely identifies a party role and location on a BOL.

billOfLadingParty.description: BOL Party specifies role and location (address) information for parties associated with a BOL.

partyRoleCode.description:
Shipping Party Role Code is an EDI-defined code value specifying the role of an organizational entity, a physical location, or an individual participating with a BOL.

Sample Values Include: PU (Party at Pickup Location), SH (Shipper), CN (Consignee), PF (Party to Receive Freight Bill)

**EDI Mapping:** DE98/N101

partyName.description:
Party Name is the fully qualified name of of a party. This must be qualified with a code defining the role that the party plays in the freight movement process to be meaningful.

**EDI Mapping:** DE93/N102

partyId.description:
Party ID serves as a unique identifier of the person, organization, or organizational component that is of interest to BNSF that can act in a legal capacity. This must be qualified with a code defining the type of party identifier used to be meaningful.

**EDI Mapping:** DE67/N104

partyFirstLineAddress.description:
Is free-form text specifying the line 1 address information for a location in which a party operates.

**EDI Mapping:** DE166/N301/N302

partySecondLineAddress.description:
Is free-form text specifying the line 2 address information for a location in which a party operates.

**EDI Mapping:** DE166/N301/N302

partyAddressCityName.description:
Party Address City Name is the fully qualified name of a city in which a party operates.

**EDI Mapping:** DE19/N401

partyAddressStateCode.description:
Party Address State Code is a code value, as defined by the appropriate government agency of the United States, Canada, or Mexico, specifying the state or province in which a party operates.

Codes sourced from the U.S. Postal Service, Canada Post, or Bureau of Transportation Statistics.

**EDI Mapping:** DE156/N402

partyAddressPostalCode.description:
Party Address Postal Code is the international postal zone code (excluding punctuation and blanks) identifying the geographical area in which a party operates.

**EDI Mapping:** DE116/N403

partyAddressCountryCode.description:
Party Address Country Code is an ISO 3166 code value specifying a country, dependency, or geopolitical area in which a party operates.

**EDI Mapping:** DE26/N404

partyEdiIdentificationQualifierCode.description:
EDI Party Identification Qualifier Code is an EDI-defined code value designating the system/method of code structure of an associated ID used to uniquely identify a party. For example, it may be used to convey that the associated ID is a telephone number, a Customer Identification File ID, or a Federal Taxpayer's ID.

Sample Values Include: C5 (Customer Identification File), 12 (Telephone Number), FI (Federal Taxpayer's Identification Number)

**EDI Mapping:** DE66/N103

billOfLadingPartyContacts.description:
Records the information of a specific contact acting as a representative of a larger party taking part in the BOL process.

**EDI Mapping:** N1 Loop/PER

billOfLadingPartyContactSequenceNumber.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID and BOL Party Sequence Number, uniquely identifies a row in the BOL Party Contact element.

partyContactEdiFunctionCode.description:
EDI Contact Function Code is an EDI-defined code value that identifies the major duty or responsibility of an associated person or group.

Sample Values Include: 1A (Review/Repricing Contact), 1B (Preferred Provider Organization (PPO) Contact), 1C (Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) Contact)

**EDI Mapping:** DE366/PER01

partyContactName.description:
Party Contact Name is the fully qualified name of a person or office who represents a party to whom communications should be directed.

**EDI Mapping:** DE93/PER02

communicationNumberEdiQualifierCode.description:
Is an EDI qualifier code that provides context to a communication number.

Typically contains the contact method such as telephone, e-mail or fax.

**EDI Mapping:** DE365/PER03/PER05/PER07

partyCommunicationNumber.description:
Party Communication Number is the complete communications number for a party including country and/or area code when applicable. This must be qualified with a code defining the type of communication number used to be meaningful.

**EDI Mapping:** DE364/PER04/PER06/PER08

billOfLadingBillingSequenceNumber.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID and BOL Party Sequence Number, uniquely identifies a row on the BOL Billing element.

carrierEdiRebillReasonCode.description: EDI Rebill Reason Code is an EDI-defined code value specifying the reason for rebill.

originFsac.description: Origin FSAC is the FSAC (Freight Station Accounting Code) for the origin point of the rate for a portion of a movement.

originSplc.description: Origin SPLC is the SPLC (Standard Point Location Code) for the origin point of the rate for a portion of a movement.

billingRateOriginCityName.description: Begin Rate City Name is the fully qualified name of a city used for the billing rate for the beginning portion of a movement.

billingRateOriginStateCode.description: Begin Rate State Code is a code value, as defined by the appropriate government agency of the United States, Canada, or Mexico, specifying the state or province used for the billing rate for the beginning portion of a movement.

billingRateOriginCountryCode.description: Begin Rate Country Code is an ISO 3166 code value specifying a country, dependency, or geopolitical area used for the billing rate for the beginning portion of a movement.

destinationFsac.description: Destination FSAC is th FSAC (Freight Station Accounting Code) for the destination point of the rate for a portion of a movement.

destinationSplc.description: Destination SPLC is the SPLC (Standard Point Location Code) for the destination point of the rate for a portion of a movement.

billingRateDestinationCityName.description: End Rate City Name is the fully qualified city name of a city used for the billing rate for the ending portion of a movement.

billingRateDestinationStateCode.description: End Rate State Code is a code value, as defined by the appropriate government agency of the United States, Canada, or Mexico, specifying the state or province used for the billing rate for the ending portion of a movement.

billingRateDestinationCountryCode.description: End Rate Country Code is an ISO 3166 code value specifying a country, dependency, or geopolitical area used for the billing rate for the ending portion of a movement.

billOfLadingBillingCarrierSequenceNumber.description: Conveys the order of a carrier participating in the rate for a rail transportation movement.

scac.description: SCAC (Standard Carrier Alpha Code) consists of a two to four character alpha abbreviation used to designate a transportation company. SCACs are assigned by NMFTA (National Motor Freight Traffic Association).

billOfLadingReferences.description:
Provides additional reference information for the shipment such as Bill of Lading number, Bill of Lading Date, Purchase Order number etc.

**EDI Mapping:** N9

billOfLadingReferenceSequenceNumber.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL Identifier, uniquely identifies a piece of reference information on a Bill of Lading.

billOfLadingReferenceEdiQualifierCode.description:
Is an EDI-defined qualifier code value that provides context to the value present in the 'EDI Reference ID' column.

**EDI Mapping:** DE128/N901

billOfLadingReferenceId.description:
BOL Reference ID is a reference identification number for the 'BOL Reference' table. Any value held in this column is contextualized and given meaning by the code value of the associated 'EDI Reference Identification Qualifier Code' column.

**EDI Mapping:** DE127/N902

billOfLadingReferenceDescription.description:
Is a free-form description meant to clarify the related BOL extended reference information.

**EDI Mapping:** DE369/N903

billOfLadingReferenceDateTime.description:
Reference DateTime is the party supplied date and/or time value for a specific BOL reference document.

Date-Time values received may be in context from customer/party locale.  The date-time value is stored in UTC time with the offset number added or subtracted to get the actual time supplied by the customer/party.

**EDI Mapping:** DE373-DE337/N904/N905

billOfLadingReferenceDateTimeUtcOffset.description:
Reference DateTime Offset Number specifies the amount of time subtracted from or added to the Coordinated Universal Time to get the time supplied for the BOL reference information.

Date-Time values received may be in context from customer/party locale.  In the EDI standard, the Time Code (N906) reflects a two character US time zone.  The supplied date, time and timezone values are converted to UTC time with the offset number added or subtracted to get the actual time supplied by the party.

**EDI Mapping:** DE623/N906

billOfLadingActivityDateTimes.description:
Records pertinent dates and times for activities on a BOL.

**EDI Mapping:** DTM

billOfLadingActivityDateSequenceNumber.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID, uniquely identifies a row in the BOL Activity date element.

billOfLadingActivityEdiDateTimeQualifier.description:
Is an EDI-defined code value which qualifies the type of action that occurred at an associated date and/or time.

**EDI Mapping:** DE374/DTM01

billOfLadingActivityDateTime.description:
Specifies the day, month, and year of an activity associated with a BOL. This must be qualified with a code defining the type of BOL activity performed to be meaningful.

**EDI Mapping:** DE373/DTM02/DE337/DTM03

billOfLadingActivityEdiTimeZoneCode.description:
Is an EDI-defined code value used to identify the time zone for an associated activity.

**EDI Mapping:** DE623/DTM04

billOfLadingHazmatIdentifications.description: Records commodity identification reference numbers and codes, as well as quantity and location (within a compartmentalized car) information, for the hazardous material being shipped.

billOfLadingHazmatIdentificationSequence.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with the BOL ID, uniquely identifies a row on the BOL Hazmat Identification Element.

hazmatEdiPackageTypeCode.description:
Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the type of package being shipped for an associated hazardous commodity movement.


**EDI Mapping:** DE355/LH101

hazmatLadingPackageQuantityCount.description:
Hazmat Lading Package Quantity Count denotes the number of packages of the hazardous material lading commodity being moved for the associated shipment.

**EDI Mapping:** DE80/LH102

hazmatUnNaIdentificationCode.description:
Is used to identify hazardous materials and articles in the framework of international transport, as required by Title 49 of the code of Federal Regulations.

**EDI Mapping:** DE277/LH103

hazmatCommodityCode.description:
Hazmat Commodity Code describes a hazmat commodity or group of hazmat commodities. Codes sourced from the Standard Transportation Commodity Code (STCC) corporate reference file.


**EDI Mapping:** DE22/LH105

hazmatLadingEdiUomCode.description:
Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the units in which, or manner in which, the measurement of the associated hazardous material lading commodity has been taken.

**EDI Mapping:** DE355/LH106

hazmatLadingMeasure.description:
Hazmat Lading Measure is a number specifying the measurement of a hazardous material lading commodity.

**EDI Mapping:** DE380/LH107

hazmatPackingGroupCode.description: Hazmat Packing Group Code is a code value defined by the Canadian government which indicates degree of danger of the hazardous material, expressed as Roman numeral I, II, or III.

hazmatUnHazmatPageNumber.description: Defines the page number of the publication where a specific hazardous commodity is described, as required for the international transport of hazardous materials.

hazmatEdiTankCarCompartmentCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value used to identify the a specific compartment of a compartmentalized tank car.

hazmatPackagingEdiContainerResidueCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value used to convey that residue from the associated material remains in the packaging (including a tank car) after it has been unloaded.

billOfLadingHazmatClassifications.description:
Records the classification, notation, and endorsement information for the hazardous material being shipped.

**EDI Mapping:** LH1 Loop/LH2

billOfLadingHazmatClassificationSequence.description: Is a sequence number that is needed to uniquely identify a row on the "BOL Hazmat Classification" table.

hazmatClassificationCode.description: Hazmat Classification Code is a code value defined by the Department of Transportation specifying the hazardous classification corresponding to the shipping name of a hazardous commodity.

hazmatEdiClassQualifierCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value qualifying an associated hazardous material class as either primary or secondary.

hazmatPlacardNotationCode.description: Hazmat Placard Notation Code is a code value defined by the Department of Transportation which specifies the placard notation corresponding to the hazard class of a hazardous commodity.

hazmatEndorsementCode.description: Hazmat Endorsement Code is a code value defined by the Department of Transportation which specifies the placard endorsement that is to be shown on the shipping papers for a hazardous commodity.

hazmatEdiReportableQuantityIndicator.description: Is an EDI code value identifying presence of hazardous substance.

hazmatFlashPointTemperatureEdiUomCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the units in which a flash point temperature is being expressed.

hazmatFlashPointTemperature.description: Hazmat Flash Point Temperature is the lowest temperature at which the vapor given off by a hazardous material will ignite on application of a flame.

hazmatExplosiveContentEdiWeightUomCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the weight unit of an associated measurement.

hazmatExplosiveContentNetWeight.description: Is the net weight of the explosive quantity of a hazardous commodity.

hazmatShippingNameList.description: Hazmat Shipping Name List records all the proper shipping names of a hazardous commodity.

hazmatEdiShippingNameQualifierCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value indicating the regulatory source of a hazardous commodity proper shipping name.

billOfLadingHazmatCommodityEmergencyCont.description: Is needed to uniquely identify a row on the "BOL Hazmat Commodity Emergency Contact" element.

partyContactEdiFunctionCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value that identifies the major duty or responsibility of an associated person or group.

partyContactName.description: Party Contact Name is the fully qualified name of a person or office who represents a party to whom communications should be directed.

communicationNumberEdiQualifierCode.description: Is an EDI qualifier code that provides context to a communication number.

partyContactCommunicationNumber.description: Is the complete communications number for a party including country and/or area code when applicable.

billOfLadingHazmatGovernmentRegulationSe.description: Is a sequence number that is needed to uniquely identify a row on the "BOL Hazmat Government Regulation" element.

hazmatEdiShipmentInformationQualifierCod.description: Is an EDI-defined code value indicating the type of hazmat shipment information being passed so that a receiver may format a description of hazardous commodity movements that meets regulatory requirements.

hazmatShipmentInformationText.description: Hazmat Line 1 Shipment Information Text is the line 1 information required by law for hazardous material shipments.

hazmatEdiInhalationToxicityHazardZoneCod.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the Department of Transportation assigned Inhalation Toxicity Hazard Zone for an associated hazardous commodity.

hazmatEdiRadioactivityUomCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the units in which a measurement of radioactivity is being expressed.

hazmatRadioactivityMeasure.description: Hazmat Radioactivity Measure is a numerical measurement of the radioactivity (radioactive decay) of a hazardous commodity.

hazmatTransportIndexNumber.description: Hazmat Transport Index Number is the transport index number for a hazardous commodity. This is a dimensionless number placed on the package label to designate the degree of control to be exercised by the carrier during transportation.

billOfLadingHazmatUsepaWasteRegulationSe.description: Is a sequence number that is needed to uniquely identify a row on the BOL Hazmat USEPA Waste Regulation table.

usepaHazardousWasteStreamCode.description: Specifies the waste stream number applicable to the movement of hazardous waste as determined by government regulations and required by the the EPA.

billOfLadingHazmatReferenceSequenceNumbe.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with the BOL ID and BOL Hazmat Identification Sequence Number, uniquely identifies a row on the "BOL Hazmat Reference" element.

hazmatReferenceEdiQualifierCode.description: Is an EDI-defined qualifier code value that provides context to the value present in the 'EDI Reference ID' column.

hazmatReferenceIdentificationNumber.description: Is a reference identification number for the 'BOL Hazmat Reference' table.

hazmatCanadianTransportationPermitExpira.description: Is the expiration date of a Transport Canada Equivalence Certificate.

billOfLadingHazmatPartySequenceNumber.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID and BOL Hazmat Identification Sequence Number, uniquely identifies a row in the BOL Hazmat Party table.

partyRoleCode.description: Party Role Code is an EDI-defined code value specifying the role of an organizational entity, a physical location, or an individual participating with a BOL.

partyName.description: Party Name is the fully qualified name of a party.

partyId.description: Party ID serves as a unique identifier of the person, organization, or organizational component that is of interest to BNSF that can act in a legal capacity.

partyFirstLineAddress.description: Is free-form text specifying the line 1 address information for a location in which a party operates.

partySecondLineAddress.description: Is free-form text specifying the line 2 address information for a location in which a party operates.

partyAddressCityName.description: Party Address City Name is the fully qualified name of a city in which a party operates.

partyAddressStateCode.description: Is a code value, as defined by the appropriate government agency of the United States, Canada, or Mexico, specifying the state or province in which a party operates.

partyAddressPostalCode.description: Party Address Postal Code is the international postal zone code (excluding punctuation and blanks) identifying the geographical area in which a party operates.

partyAddressCountryCode.description: Party Address Country Code is an ISO 3166 code value specifying a country, dependency, or geopolitical area in which a party operates.

partyEdiIdentificationQualifierCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value designating the system/method of code structure of an associated ID used to uniquely identify a party.

billOfLadingHazmatWastePartyContactSeque.description: Is a sequence number that is needed to uniquely identify an element in the BOL Hazmat Waste Party Contact complex element.

partyContactEdiFunctionCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value that identifies the major duty or responsibility of an associated person or group.

partyContactName.description: Party Contact Name is the fully qualified name of a person or office who represents a party to whom communications should be directed.

communicationNumberEdiQualifierCode.description: Is an EDI qualifier code that provides context to a communication number.

partyCommunicationNumber.description: Party Communication Number is the complete communications number for a party including country and/or area code when applicable.

billOfLadingHazmatCanadianGovernmentRegu.description: Is a sequence number that is needed to uniquely identify a row on the "BOL Hazmat Canadian Government Regulation" element.

hazmatEmergencyResponsePlanId.description: Is the identity number of a specific hazardous emergency response plan that is assigned by the Director General of Canada.

hazmatEmergencyResponsePlanPhoneNumber.description: Is the complete phone number including country or area code that has been provided as part of the associated Canadian emergency response plan.

billOfLadingHazmatCertificationSequenceN.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with the BOL ID, uniquely identifies a row on the BOL Hazmat Certification element.

hazmatShipmentCertifierName.description: Is name of the person certifying that a hazardous material shipment complies with regulations.

billOfLadingHazmatShipmentEmergencyConta.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with the BOL ID, uniquely identifies a row on the BOL Hazmat Shipment Emergency Contact element.

partyContactEdiFunctionCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value that identifies the major duty or responsibility of an associated person or group.

partyContactName.description: Party Contact Name is the fully qualified name of a person or office who represents a party to whom communications should be directed.

communicationNumberEdiQualifierCode.description: Is an EDI qualifier code that provides context to a communication number.

partyContactCommunicationNumber.description: Is the complete communications number for a party including country and/or area code when applicable.

billOfLadingProtectiveServiceInstruction.description: Is a sequence number that plays a part in uniquely identifying an instance of mechanical protective service and ventilation instructions that applies to a shipment.

protectiveServiceRuleCode.description: Protective Service Rule Code is an AAR-defined code value which specifies a protective service (heating or cooling) that applies to a shipment.

protectiveServiceEdiCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying a perishable protective service that applies to a shipment.

optimumShipmentTemperatureEdiUomCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value specifying the units in which a value is being expressed, or manner in which a measurement has been taken.

optimumShipmentTemperature.description: Optimum Shipment Temperature is the optimum allowable temperature condition for a shipment.

scac.description: SCAC (Standard Carrier Alpha Code) consists of a two to four character alpha abbreviation used to designate a transportation company. SCACs are assigned by NMFTA (National Motor Freight Traffic Association).

fsac.description: FSAC (Freight Station Accounting Code) is a number assigned to a station that uniquely identifies the station within the context of each reporting railroad (i.e., Different railroads might share identical FSAC numbers).

stationCityName.description: Is the fully qualified name of a city where a station that contains a scale is located.

stationStateCode.description: Station State Code is a code value, as defined by the appropriate government agency of the United States, Canada, or Mexico, specifying the state or province of a station.

shipmentPrecoolIndicator.description: Indicates whether or not the shipment was precooled per Association of American Railroads (AAR) Protective Service Rule 710.

equipmentEdiHeaterLocationCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value to specify the heater location for freight conveyance equipment requiring protective service.

foodCommodityShipmentEdiIndicatorCode.description: Is an EDI-defined code value to identify whether or not an associated commodity is a food product.

equipmentEdiDoorwaySpaceWidthCode.description: Is an 'EDI' defined code value which specifies the amount of doorway space for the full width of a car.

protectiveServiceShipmentOriginTemperatu.description: Specifies the temperature of a shipment requiring a protective service at the origin location.

chassisId.description: Serves as an identifier for a piece of freight conveyance equipment. It consists of a 4-character equipment initial followed by an up to 15-character equipment unit identifying number.

chassisOwnerScac.description: Chassis Owner SCAC is the standard carrier alpha code for the owner of the associated freight conveyance equipment.

chassisLesseeScac.description: Chassis Lessee SCAC is the standard carrier alpha code for the lessee of the associated freight conveyance equipment.

chassisTareWeight.description: Chassis Tare Weight is the weight of an empty rail shipping container or vehicle. Sometimes called the unladen weight.

chassisTareQualifierCode.description: Is the code identifying the type of tare weight of an empty rail shipping container or vehicle. Sometimes called the unladen weight.

chassisExteriorLengthFeetInches.description: Chassis Exterior Length Feet Inches is the length (in feet and inches) of equipment ordered or used to transport shipment.

billOfLadingChassisTypeCode.description: BOL Chassis Type Code is a BNSF-defined code value which specifies the type of rail conveyance equipment (Intermodal or Railcar) applicable to a particular operating partner agreement.

chassisCheckDigitNumber.description: Chassis Check Digit Number designates the check digit applied to a piece of equipment, which serves as a form of redundancy check used for error detection.

shipmentSpecialChargeEdiCurrencyCode.description: Shipment Special Charge EDI Currency Code is an EDI-defined code value specifying the Standard ISO code for country in whose currency the charges are specified.

transactionEdiRelatedCompanyIndicator.description: Transaction EDI Related Company Indicator specifies whether the two parties in a transaction are related.

shipmentSpecialChargeEdiQualifierCode.description: Shipment Special Charge EDI Qualifier Code is an EDI-defined code value specifying the type of special charge or allowance associated with a shipment. ('595' = Proforma Invoice, 'FCB' = Freight Changes to Border, 'FCD' = Freight Changes to Destination)

shipmentSpecialChargeAmount.description: Shipment Special Charge Amount is the total monetary amount of a special charge included on the total invoice for a shipment, in the standard monetary denomination for the currency specified.

portEdiBlockTwentyQualifierCode.description: Port EDI Block Twenty Qualifier Code is an EDI-defined code value used to define Block 20 characteristics.

commodityChemicalAnalysisPercentage.description: Chemical Analysis Percentage is a percentage of a specific chemical component that makes up a complete product, which is required to be reported by U.S. and Canada Customs.

ladingUnitPrice.description: Lading Unit Price is the price per unit of a commodity.

billOfLadingCustomsInformationSequenceNu.description: Is a sequence number that in combination with BOL ID, uniquely identifies a row in the BOL Customs Information element.

equipmentInitial.description: Equipment Initial is the prefix or alphabetic part of an equipment units identifying number.

equipmentNumber.description: Equipment Number is the sequencing or serial part of an equipment units identifying number.

loadEmptyCode.description:
Code which indicates the load status of a piece of equipment.
Valid values are: L = Loaded, E = Empty, B = Both

equipmentGrossScaleWeightPounds.description: The gross scale weight of a piece of equipment as measured in pounds.

equipmentTareWeightPounds.description: The weight of an empty vehicle or container, as measured in pounds, without cargo. Sometimes referred to as Unladen Weight.

shipmentNetScaleWeightPounds.description: The net scale weight of a shipment, as measured in pounds.

carKindCode.description: Code that identifies the physical characteristics for equipment as defined by BNSF Railway itself. Value is used when car characteristics are required for business decision making.

billOfLadingId.description: Is a unique identifier for an instance of an internal or external customer request for the Bill of Lading via rail.

waybillNumber.description: Waybill Number is the carrier accounting number of a waybill.

waybillVersionNumber.description: Number added to a specific Waybill to allow for versioning of the Waybill over time.

shippingManifestId.description: Identifier of a Shipping Manifest which is a list of all goods loaded onto a transport vessel. A manifest usually documents the items, quantity, weight, and the destination information for where the cargo is to go.

waybillDate.description: Waybill Date is the day, month, and year specified on a waybill, expressed as CCYYMMDD where CC represents the first two digits of the calendar year. Can not be in the future.

waybillEdiCode.description: Code which defines if the Waybill has an EDI code.

waybillStatusCode.description: BNSF defined code values to track the operational lifecycle state of a Waybill's execution from initialization to close. Valid Values Include: A=ACTIVATED, C=CLOSED CYCLE, O=OFFLINE, S=SUSPENDED, V=VOIDED

waybillParties.description: Information on interested or responsible parties associated with a Waybill.

waybillPartyRoleName.description: Description of the Waybill Party Role Code value which provides the full name associated with the role.

waybillPartyFullName.description: Full name of a Party (business or individual) that plays a part within a Waybill.

originStationName.description: The fully spelled out name of an origin station.

originStateCode.description: The code, as assigned by a national body such as the US Postal Service, for a state, province, or territory for a given origin.

destinationStationName.description: The fully spelled out name of an destination station.

destinationStateCode.description: The code, as assigned by a national body such as the US Postal Service, for a state, province, or territory for a given destination.

stcc.description: STCC (Standard Transportation Commodity Code) number identifying a Commodity.

commodityDescription.description: Text value which describes a Commodity.

contractFreightRateQuoteNumber.description: Number assigned to identify a quote generated for a Contract Freight Rate.

aarRule11Indicator.description: Indicates if AAR (Association of American Railroads) Rule 11 applies to the shipment.  This rule identifies the proper billing procedure that must be followed by each party in scenarios in which through waybilling of shipments require more than one carrier to collect.

shipmentUnitCount.description: Number of pieces of equipment that are being moved in a shipment.

aarRule260JunctionAbbreviation.description: The AAR Rule 260 junction abbreviation associated with a segment of the route for a Waybill where two rail carriers will exchange shipments.

waybillRouteSequenceNumber.description: A value that defines the sequence within a full Waybill route the associated portion of a route pertains.

waybillDiversions.description: Diversions allow a customer to update a waybill to divert a shipment to a different destination or to update the consignee.

consigneeFullName.description: The full name of a customer that is filling the role of Consignee. A Consignee, also referred to as the "Receiver", is the company or individual receiving a shipment at a destination.

waybillDiversionAuthorizedByName.description: The full name of the person who authorized the Waybill Diversion.

waybillDiversionRequesterPhoneNumber.description: Phone number of the person who requested the Waybill Diversion.

waybillDiversionDate.description: Full calendar date when the Waybill Diversion occurred.

waybillDiversionTime.description: Time when the Waybill Diversion occurred. Formatted as HHMMSS.

waybillDiversionComments.description: Any comments related to the diversion(s) made to the original Waybill.

waybillDiversionComment.description: Comments entered related to any diversions made to a Waybill. Diversions allow a customer to update a waybill to divert a shipment to a different destination or to update the consignee.

waybillHazardousCommodities.description: Details about any hazardous commodities/materials being hauled under the associated Waybill.

unNorthAmericanHazardousCommodityNumber.description: UN (United Nations) or North American Hazardous Commodity Number (BOE 6000).

hazardousCommodityTechnicalName.description: The technical name for a Hazardous Commodity.

hazardousCommodityProperShippingName.description: The full name of a Proper Shipping name assigned to a Hazardous Commodities as required by US, Canadian, and International Regulations.

hazardousSubstanceChemicalComponent.description: The chemical component(s) identified for a given Hazardous Commodity.

hazardousCommodityClassificationCode.description: Code indicating the classification applied to a hazardous commodity. May include Canadian, United States, and international codes depending on the data storage file and the type of shipments.

canadianHazardousCommoditySubsidiaryClas.description: The first, primary, Canadian Hazardous Commodity Subsidiary Classification associated with a given material being shipped.
The second, secondary, Canadian Hazardous Commodity Subsidiary Classification associated with a given material being shipped.

packagingGroupCode.description: Code which designates the Canadian or International Packaging Group assigned to a shipment.

stcc.description: STCC (Standard Transportation Commodity Code) number identifying a Commodity.

commodityAdditionalDescriptiveInformatio.description: Additional descriptive information recorded for a Commodity, tariff, or other relevant data.
commodityAdditionalDescriptiveInformatio.example: CONTAINS NOT LESS THAN 48% WATER BY WEIGHT

hazardousMaterialShipmentWeightPounds.description: The weight, as measured in pounds, of a Hazardous Material shipment.

reportableHazardousMaterialQuantityIndic.description: Indicates if the quantity of a hazardous commodity must be reported to the US or State DOT (Department of Transportation) agency.

customerNotificationPhoneNumber.description: Telephone number to be used to notify a Customer of any important information.

waybillHazardousMaterialComment.description: A comment entered about hazardous materials found on a Waybill.

waybillVessels.description: Information on any sailing vessel(s) associated with freight movement under the associated Waybill.

sailingDate.description: The date a sailing vessel is to depart (formatted as  YYYY-MM-DD).

sailingTime.description: The time a sailing vessel is to depart (formatted as HH:MM).

vesselInboundOutboundCode.description: Code which defines the high level movement of a vessel, inbound or outbound.

vesselName.description: Name of a sailing vessel as documented in "Lloyd's Register of Ships".

vesselVoyageNumber.description: Number associated with a vessel's voyage that identifies the voyage cargo is shipped under.

vesselTerminalName.description: Name of a terminal, within a given port, a sailing vessel may begin or end a voyage from.

vesselPortName.description: Name of a port, a maritime facility, from which a sailing vessel may begin or end a voyage from.

pierName.description: Name of a pier a sailing vessel may begin or end a voyage from

vesselBookingNumber.description: The number, assigned by a carrier, for the reservation of space aboard a shipping vessel.

vesselBookingDate.description: The date a sailing vessel has been booked, space has been reserved, by a Carrier (formatted as  YYYY-MM-DD).

scheduledUnitAvailabilityDate.description: Date a given unit is scheduled to be available (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD).

scheduledUnitAvailabilityTime.description: Time a given unit is scheduled to be available (formatted as HH:SS).

requestedUnitAvailabilityDate.description: Date a given unit is requested to be made available to the Customer (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD).

requestedUnitAvailabilityTime.description: Time a given unit is requested to be made available to the Customer (formatted as HH:MM).

plannedUnitAvailabilityDate.description: Date a given unit is planned to be made available to the Customer (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD).

plannedUnitAvailabilityTime.description: Time a given unit is planned to be made available to the Customer (formatted as HH:MM).

waybillErrorDescription.description: Full description of an error generated when Waybill information was entered.
waybillErrorDescription.example: ORIGIN ROAD (BNSF) DOES NOT SERVE ORIGIN (TOLUCA EM).

waybillSpecialInstructions.description: Any special instructions to be communicated or followed during the execution of a Waybill.
waybillSpecialInstructions.example: RULE 705: OPTIM TEMP 0 OR LESS DO NOT HEAT IN CANADA

waybillSpecialConditionCode.description: Code that defines a special condition to be considered during the execution of a Waybill.

waybillSpecialConditionName.description: Descriptive name, assigned to a special condition code, that defines a special condition to be considered during the execution of a Waybill.

equipmentInitial.description: Equipment Initial is the prefix or alphabetic part of an equipment units identifying number.

equipmentNumber.description: Equipment Number is the sequencing or serial part of an equipment units identifying number.

totalLadingWeightPounds.description: Total chargeable weight (lading weight) for a specific Railcar as measured in pounds.

waybillReferenceNumberTypeCode.description: A code defining the type of reference number or identifier associated with a Waybill.

waybillReferenceNumberTypeName.description: A short, free-form description of a code defining the type of reference number or identifier associated with a Waybill.

waybillReferenceNumber.description: A reference number or identifier associated with a Waybill.

400.description:
**Bad Request**

The request could not be understood by the server due to incorrect syntax. Do not repeat the request without modifications.

401.description:
**Unauthorized**

Indicates that the request requires user authentication information. The client MAY repeat the request with a suitable Authorization.

403.description:
Unauthorized request. Here are the most common causes:
    
* You are getting 403 Access Denied.

   * It takes a few days for us to get you set up after you register. When set up is complete, you will receive an email letting you know. If you have not received the email, please wait up to five business days. Let us know via API Support if you still have not received the email after five business days.
   * You can also get this error if your certificate is not configured properly on your side. Please review the Mutual Authentication in the Getting Started section of our documentation.


* You are getting 403 "message": "Insufficient privileges" when accessing a restricted service for which you do not have permission. You can use our Registration form to request access. Be sure to explain the situation in the "Please explain how you intend to use the API" field.

404.description:
**Not Found**

The server cannot find the requested resource (URI). That is, the address of the endpoint in your request does not exist. Please consult the documentation.

405.description:
**Method Not Allowed**

The request HTTP method is known by the server but has been disabled and cannot be used for that resource. For example, you may be using GET when POST is required. Please consult the documentation.

429.description:
**Too Many Requests**

The BNSF API Gateway enforces rate limits to maintain application security and performance.  Current rate limits are set as follows:
* 1 API Request Per Second, Per Partner, Per Service
* 15 API Requests Per Minute, Per Partner, Per Service
* 100 API Request Per Minute, Per Service
 
When requests exceed these limits the API Gateway will return a **429 Too Many Requests** error response. Upon receiving such exceptions, you can resubmit failed requests in a rate-limited manner, complying with the API Gateway throttle limits.

500.description:
**Internal Server Error**

The server encountered an unexpected condition which prevented it from fulfilling the request. This is always a problem on the server side. Our internal support systems will be made aware.

504.description:
**Gateway Timeout**

The server is acting as a gateway and cannot get a response in time for a request. Wait about one minute then try again.
